overall_summary: View counts across all uploaded shorts remain extremely low (3 to 40 views), indicating that overall channel reach and algorithmic discovery are still in the early exploration phase. However, self respect topics combined with specific tangible smartphone actions (like deleting chats or unnamed numbers) show slightly better baseline views compared to abstract late-night musings.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on concrete phone actions under 'self respect' (e.g., 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' with 40 views, and 'बिना नाम के सेव किया था नंबर' with 26 views) outperformed abstract emotional ones.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks and stories around physical, everyday smartphone triggers related to digital boundaries and self-worth.

weak_patterns.evidence: Openings like 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (5 views) yielded lower engagement in this sample size.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely atmospheric openings; anchor the start of the story into an active, immediate decision or action.

next_video.concept: A story about clearing out old archived photos in the gallery that were kept hidden, symbolizing final emotional detachment rather than just messaging apps.
